title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Speed Time Distance Races
subject: Quant

questions.q: A train travelled a certain distance at a uniform speed. Had the speed been 6 km per hour more, it would have needed 4 hours less. Had the speed been 6 km per hour less, it would have needed 6 hours more. The distance, in km, travelled by the train is:
questions.explain: Let distance be d, speed s, time t. d=st. We have $d = (s+6)(t-4)$ and $d = (s-6)(t+6)$. Solving these two equations gives s=30 and t=24. Distance = 30*24=720 km.
questions.subject: Quant
